requirement: Exactly one visible main landmark
pass_condition: One non-hidden main contains the page-specific primary content.
fail_condition: Missing or duplicate main landmarks obscure the dominant content region.
solution_pattern: Add one main around unique content; remove, hide correctly, or refactor duplicates.

requirement: Main has valid ancestry
pass_condition: Main is not descended from article, aside, footer, header, or nav.
fail_condition: The structure violates main content-model constraints.
solution_pattern: Move main to the document body level outside those elements.

requirement: Sections are named
pass_condition: Each meaningful section has a heading, or a justified accessible label.
fail_condition: An unnamed section may add no useful structure and may produce an unnamed region.
solution_pattern: Add a descriptive heading or use div when no thematic section exists.

requirement: Articles stand independently
pass_condition: Each article is intelligible and reusable outside the immediate page.
fail_condition: A layout wrapper has been mislabeled as independent content.
solution_pattern: Use section or div unless the block is a standalone composition.

requirement: Nav is reserved for major navigation
pass_condition: Each nav represents a major navigation block.
fail_condition: Too many nav landmarks reduce navigational value.
solution_pattern: Use ordinary containers for minor link groups.

requirement: Repeated landmarks have distinct names
pass_condition: Landmarks of the same type have unique browser-computed accessible names when distinction is required.
fail_condition: Users cannot distinguish repeated landmarks in landmark navigation.
solution_pattern: Use aria-labelledby with a visible heading or a concise aria-label; verify the computed name rather than the attribute alone.

requirement: Headings encode hierarchy
pass_condition: Headings identify content sections and levels follow nesting intent.
fail_condition: Styling-driven headings distort programmatic structure.
solution_pattern: Select levels for hierarchy and use CSS for size.

requirement: Figure captions are structurally associated
pass_condition: Figcaption is the first or last child of figure.
fail_condition: Caption meaning may not be associated as intended.
solution_pattern: Move figcaption inside figure at the first or last position.

requirement: Dates use valid datetime values
pass_condition: Datetime is absent only when text is machine-readable, or contains a valid HTML date/time/duration.
fail_condition: Ambiguous or invalid values defeat machine readability.
solution_pattern: Add a valid datetime value while keeping human-readable text.

requirement: Disclosure widgets use details and summary correctly
pass_condition: Each details begins with a usable summary and works with keyboard input.
fail_condition: The disclosure lacks a native name or interaction behavior.
solution_pattern: Add summary as the first child or implement an accessible custom pattern only when necessary.

requirement: Native interactive elements are used
pass_condition: Links navigate; buttons perform actions; native controls expose the expected role, name, focus behavior, keyboard behavior, and state.
fail_condition: Generic containers or mismatched controls lack dependable role, keyboard, focus, state, or action behavior.
solution_pattern: Replace the control with the matching native element; preserve a useful computed name and verify interaction behavior.
validation_method: DOM, computed accessibility tree, focus, keyboard, and activation test

requirement: Tables represent data, not layout
pass_condition: Every table represents row-column data and uses caption/th associations as needed.
fail_condition: Layout tables create misleading navigation and relationships.
solution_pattern: Use CSS layout for presentation; repair data-table headers and caption.

requirement: Semantic choice follows meaning
pass_condition: Elements are chosen for purpose; CSS supplies presentation.
fail_condition: Appearance-driven element choice corrupts document meaning.
solution_pattern: Replace misused elements and preserve visuals through CSS.

requirement: ARIA does not conflict with native semantics
pass_condition: ARIA supplements native semantics without changing the computed role or state to an inaccurate value.
fail_condition: Redundant or conflicting ARIA produces an inaccurate accessibility object.
solution_pattern: Remove redundant or conflicting ARIA, prefer native HTML, and recheck the computed accessibility node.
validation_method: Compare native semantics, ARIA attributes, and browser-computed role/state

requirement: Rendered DOM preserves semantic structure
pass_condition: Rendering does not remove, duplicate, hide, or reorder essential headings, landmarks, controls, names, states, and content relationships.
fail_condition: Users, assistive technologies, and crawlers may receive inconsistent structures or interaction states.
solution_pattern: Correct templates, hydration, CSS ordering, or component state; retest the rendered DOM and full accessibility tree.
validation_method: Compare initial HTML, rendered DOM, full accessibility tree, and responsive source order

applies_to: landmarks, controls, images, widgets, and structural elements
requirement: Computed role matches intended purpose
pass_condition: The browser-computed role matches the element purpose and expected interaction.
fail_condition: Native or ARIA semantics expose the wrong object type.
solution_pattern: Use the correct native element or remove the conflicting role; recheck the computed node.

applies_to: controls, landmarks, images, dialogs, frames, and form fields
requirement: Accessible name and description resolve correctly
pass_condition: Required objects have accurate, non-empty, non-conflicting names; the computed name contains the visible control wording where a visible label exists.
fail_condition: A name or description is absent, duplicated, misleading, or disconnected from the visible label or purpose.
solution_pattern: Repair label, alt, aria-labelledby, aria-label, aria-describedby, or host-language naming relationships; verify computed output.
validation_method: Computed name and description inspection plus visible-label comparison

applies_to: hidden, collapsed, off-canvas, inactive, and decorative content
requirement: Hidden and ignored-node exposure is intentional
pass_condition: Hidden or inactive content is excluded as intended; visible meaningful content remains exposed; excluded subtrees contain no focusable descendants.
fail_condition: Meaningful content is ignored, or a focusable object remains inside an excluded subtree.
solution_pattern: Repair hidden, inert, aria-hidden, CSS visibility, or focus handling and inspect the ignored-node reason.
validation_method: Compare rendered visibility, focusability, DOM state, and accessibility-tree exposure

applies_to: accordions, tabs, menus, dialogs, carousels, forms, and custom widgets
requirement: Dynamic states remain synchronized
pass_condition: Expanded, selected, checked, pressed, current, invalid, busy, disabled, and modal states match the visible interface before and after interaction.
fail_condition: The visual state changes without the corresponding native or ARIA state update.
solution_pattern: Update the native state or correct ARIA property during the same interaction; retest every state transition.
validation_method: Interact with the component and compare visual state with computed accessibility state

requirement: Focus, keyboard behavior, and exposed action agree
pass_condition: Role, focusability, keyboard command, state, and resulting action follow the native element or documented widget pattern.
fail_condition: An element claims an interactive role without matching focus or keyboard behavior, or navigation and action semantics are confused.
solution_pattern: Use a native link for navigation and a native button for actions; implement the complete keyboard pattern only when a custom widget is unavoidable.
validation_method: Computed role inspection plus Tab, Enter, Space, arrow-key, and Escape testing where relevant

applies_to: grids, split layouts, responsive sections, and reordered components
requirement: DOM, visual, focus, and accessibility order remain logical
pass_condition: Reading and focus sequences remain meaningful and equivalent enough to preserve relationships at each tested viewport.
fail_condition: CSS or JavaScript reordering creates conflicting visual, reading, or focus sequences.
solution_pattern: Correct source order first and use layout CSS without changing the meaningful sequence.
validation_method: Compare DOM order, visual order, keyboard focus order, and full accessibility-tree order at each relevant breakpoint

applies_to: page-level validation and key user journeys
requirement: Critical paths receive manual accessibility verification
pass_condition: Critical navigation, forms, disclosures, dialogs, and conversion actions work beyond static markup and automated checks.
fail_condition: Approval relies only on source markup, a crawler, Lighthouse, or the DevTools tree.
solution_pattern: Complete keyboard testing and a relevant browser and assistive-technology spot check; record the environment and result.
validation_method: DevTools tree review, keyboard test, and selected assistive-technology spot check

requirement: Declare the document language
pass_condition: The html element has the correct lang value
fail_condition: Lang is missing or incorrect
solution_pattern: Set the correct BCP 47 language tag

requirement: Provide a unique descriptive title
pass_condition: The title identifies the page and distinguishes it from sibling pages
fail_condition: Title is missing duplicated or generic
solution_pattern: Write a page-specific title from the visible purpose

requirement: Keep indexing directives internally consistent
pass_condition: Canonical robots headers and visible page intent do not conflict
fail_condition: Directives conflict or target an unintended URL
solution_pattern: Correct the conflicting directive and chosen canonical

requirement: Keep primary content recoverable after rendering
pass_condition: Primary task content appears reliably in the rendered DOM
fail_condition: Hydration failure or blocked resources remove primary content
solution_pattern: Server render or repair deterministic rendering
validation_method: Compare source rendered DOM and JS error state

requirement: Represent the site header separately
pass_condition: Header content is identifiable and outside main
fail_condition: Shared header is mixed into primary content
solution_pattern: Use a scoped header outside main

requirement: Represent the site footer separately
pass_condition: Footer content is identifiable and outside main
fail_condition: Footer interrupts or becomes part of primary content
solution_pattern: Use a body-level footer outside main

trigger: Keyboard users must bypass repeated content
requirement: Provide a working skip route
pass_condition: Skip link becomes visible on focus and moves to main content
fail_condition: Skip control is absent broken or hidden from keyboard users
solution_pattern: Add a focus-visible skip link to main

requirement: Represent hierarchy truthfully
pass_condition: Breadcrumb order current page and destinations match the site hierarchy
fail_condition: Path is false incomplete or inconsistent with schema
solution_pattern: Correct visible and structured breadcrumb data
validation_method: Compare links visible path and schema

requirement: Provide a page-level heading
pass_condition: One H1 identifies the primary page subject
fail_condition: H1 is missing duplicated without reason or unrelated to purpose
solution_pattern: Create one descriptive H1 inside main
validation_method: Inspect heading outline and visible page

requirement: Keep DOM visual and accessibility narratives compatible
pass_condition: Primary task and supporting content appear in a compatible order across representations
fail_condition: CSS reordering or hidden content changes the narrative
solution_pattern: Correct DOM order and use CSS without semantic reordering
validation_method: Compare desktop mobile DOM and accessibility order

requirement: State and support the dominant user task
pass_condition: Reviewers can identify the same primary purpose and region
fail_condition: Primary purpose is ambiguous or displaced by boilerplate
solution_pattern: Clarify the opening task and primary region
validation_method: Run human DOM reader and accessibility review

trigger: A direct answer or primary function is expected
requirement: Place the task before avoidable secondary friction
pass_condition: The answer or function appears at the earliest logical point
fail_condition: Long unrelated introductions navigation or promotion precedes it
solution_pattern: Move or rewrite intervening secondary content
validation_method: Measure discovery in DOM and user task test

requirement: Use links for navigation with meaningful purpose
pass_condition: Destination and anchor purpose are understandable in context
fail_condition: Links are empty misleading or impersonate actions
solution_pattern: Rewrite anchor content and correct destination semantics

requirement: Use an operable named action control
pass_condition: Button has an accessible name and expected keyboard behavior
fail_condition: Clickable non-control or unnamed action is used
solution_pattern: Use button and expose its name and state

requirement: Keep accessible and visible names aligned
pass_condition: Accessible name describes the same function as visible text
fail_condition: Accessible name hides or contradicts visible purpose
solution_pattern: Use visible label or matching labelledby reference
validation_method: Compare visible text and computed name

requirement: Associate every input with a label
pass_condition: Each input has a programmatically associated meaningful label
fail_condition: Input relies on placeholder or proximity alone
solution_pattern: Use label for/id or native grouping
validation_method: Inspect accessible names and click labels

trigger: Inputs require format unit or constraints
requirement: Expose requirements before submission
pass_condition: Units formats and required state are understandable
fail_condition: Constraints appear only after failure or remain implicit
solution_pattern: Add visible instructions and descriptions

requirement: Identify errors and recovery
pass_condition: Errors name the field problem and correction and receive suitable focus/announcement
fail_condition: Errors are color-only generic or inaccessible
solution_pattern: Link specific messages and manage focus/live state
validation_method: Submit invalid data with keyboard and screen reader

requirement: Expose success and result state
pass_condition: Outcome is visible understandable and programmatically available
fail_condition: State changes silently or ambiguously
solution_pattern: Add result heading status/live behavior and focus strategy

requirement: Provide purpose-appropriate text alternative
pass_condition: Alt conveys the image's relevant purpose
fail_condition: Alt is missing generic filename or unrelated
solution_pattern: Write concise contextual alt text
validation_method: Inspect image with and without rendering

requirement: Remove decorative images from the accessibility narrative
pass_condition: Decorative image has empty alt or CSS treatment
fail_condition: Decorative image receives redundant spoken text
solution_pattern: Use empty alt and omit unnecessary ARIA

trigger: Image contains decision-critical text or numbers
requirement: Provide critical information as native synchronized content
pass_condition: Values remain available outside pixels and agree everywhere
fail_condition: Image is the only source or conflicts with prose/table
solution_pattern: Reproduce data in nearby text or table and synchronize it
validation_method: Compare image prose table and schema

requirement: Preserve row and column associations
pass_condition: Table has useful caption and header relationships
fail_condition: Div grid or malformed table loses associations
solution_pattern: Use native table caption th and scope/header relations
validation_method: Inspect with CSS off and accessibility tree

requirement: Preserve list relationships
pass_condition: Repeated items use an appropriate list structure
fail_condition: Visual bullets or divs lose list semantics
solution_pattern: Use ul ol or dl according to meaning

trigger: Shared controls ads or promotions present
requirement: Keep boilerplate outside prose boundaries
pass_condition: Secondary regions remain coherent siblings of primary prose
fail_condition: Controls or promotions split sentences or pollute extraction
solution_pattern: Move the region to a labelled sibling container

requirement: Label related content as secondary
pass_condition: Region purpose and destination relationship are clear
fail_condition: Related content appears as primary prose or unexplained links
solution_pattern: Use a labelled related-content region

trigger: Material factual or quantitative claims present
requirement: Record adequate claim context and source
pass_condition: Claim includes needed unit population date method and source
fail_condition: Claim lacks qualifiers or traceable evidence
solution_pattern: Add supplied evidence and qualifiers or remove unsupported precision
validation_method: Trace each claim to supplied source

trigger: A fact appears in multiple representations
requirement: Keep repeated facts synchronized
pass_condition: Prose UI media tables and schema agree
fail_condition: Values names dates units or availability conflict
solution_pattern: Choose the supported value and update every representation

requirement: Keep markup consistent with visible content
pass_condition: Entities properties and values are visible and supported
fail_condition: Markup adds hidden unsupported or conflicting claims
solution_pattern: Remove unsupported properties and align remaining markup
validation_method: Validate syntax then compare with visible page

requirement: Preserve task access and meaning across breakpoints
pass_condition: Primary content controls and relationships work on mobile and desktop
fail_condition: Content hides overlaps reorders harmfully or becomes unusable
solution_pattern: Repair responsive layout without semantic reordering
validation_method: Test representative mobile and desktop viewports

trigger: Lazy or dynamically inserted primary content exists
requirement: Insert content into the correct semantic region
pass_condition: Dynamic nodes retain expected containment labels and order
fail_condition: Content moves into unrelated containers or never appears
solution_pattern: Repair insertion target loading fallback and state
validation_method: Test slow failure and completed states

requirement: Report performance as a measured user input
pass_condition: Metric is named with lab/field context and page state
fail_condition: Generic page size or DOM count is treated as a ranking score
solution_pattern: Report qualified metrics and fix measured bottleneck
validation_method: Repeat named measurement under same conditions

requirement: Use one coherent article body
pass_condition: Header answer sections evidence and author context form one article
fail_condition: Article content is fragmented across unrelated regions
solution_pattern: Group article-specific content in article within main

requirement: Provide a concise supported answer before deep detail
pass_condition: Opening resolves the question with necessary qualification
fail_condition: Opening delays or evades the answer
solution_pattern: Add an evidence-aligned answer summary

requirement: Identify provider service audience and scope
pass_condition: Opening establishes the supported service relationship
fail_condition: Generic copy leaves the offering unclear
solution_pattern: Rewrite the proposition with supplied facts
validation_method: Review extracted opening without branding visuals

requirement: Keep CTA truthful and connected to the service
pass_condition: Action states what happens next and does not replace evidence
fail_condition: CTA is deceptive unsupported or dominates before scope
solution_pattern: Correct action label flow and supporting context
validation_method: Complete contact path and inspect confirmation

requirement: Support the provider-location relationship
pass_condition: Visible business facts substantiate the claimed area
fail_condition: Unsupported office service area proximity or local superlative is asserted
solution_pattern: Use verified NAP/service-area evidence or remove claim
validation_method: Compare supplied business records and page

requirement: Expose decision and offer attributes
pass_condition: Product variant price unit availability and policies are understandable
fail_condition: Material offer data is absent or contradictory
solution_pattern: Add supported offer and selection data

requirement: Make collection scope and items recoverable
pass_condition: Category rule controls result state and item attributes are clear
fail_condition: Grid lacks scope labels state or recoverable items
solution_pattern: Add category context semantic controls and item structure
validation_method: Test filter sort empty and pagination states

requirement: Compare alternatives on consistent disclosed dimensions
pass_condition: Criteria evidence date and trade-offs apply consistently
fail_condition: Alternatives use selective or changing criteria
solution_pattern: Define the method and normalize comparison fields
validation_method: Trace each conclusion to criteria and evidence

requirement: Provide a truthful functioning primary tool
pass_condition: Valid inputs produce an explained result with units and assumptions
fail_condition: Widget is decorative broken or unexplained
solution_pattern: Repair computation labels output method and error states
validation_method: Test valid boundary and invalid inputs

requirement: Disclose inclusion ordering and verification context
pass_condition: Users can understand why entries appear and how current they are
fail_condition: Ranking or inclusion method is hidden or misleading
solution_pattern: Publish method date verification and commercial disclosure
validation_method: Trace entries and ordering to method

requirement: Establish entity identity and prioritized tasks
pass_condition: Entity audience offerings evidence and routes are clear
fail_condition: Homepage lacks identity or gives all tasks equal weight
solution_pattern: Clarify proposition and task hierarchy

requirement: State channels requirements consent and expectations
pass_condition: User understands submission and response or booking status
fail_condition: Request is represented as confirmed booking or lacks outcome
solution_pattern: Correct form copy consent confirmation and availability logic
validation_method: Submit and verify every outcome state

requirement: Keep questions visible distinct and directly answered
pass_condition: Each question has a matching visible answer
fail_condition: Questions duplicate remain unanswered or schema differs
solution_pattern: Rewrite visible Q&A and synchronize applicable markup

requirement: Expose source authorship date and moderation context
pass_condition: Contribution provenance and status are understandable
fail_condition: Curated or generated text impersonates independent users
solution_pattern: Disclose origin verification moderation and relationships

requirement: Use Not Testable rather than guessing
pass_condition: Missing evidence and resulting limit are recorded
fail_condition: Auditor invents a result or silently skips the rule
solution_pattern: Request the missing representation or retain Not Testable

trigger: Search impact or hidden mechanism is discussed
requirement: Separate observed inputs from causal SEO claims
pass_condition: Language matches the available evidence
fail_condition: A hidden mechanism or ranking result is presented as observed
solution_pattern: Rewrite as a bounded hypothesis requiring controlled testing

requirement: Total DOM node count within budget
pass_condition: dom_node_count <= 1500 and max_depth <= 32 and max_children <= 60
fail_condition: dom_node_count > 1500 (fail) or > 800 (warn); depth > 32; any parent > 60 children
solution_pattern: Flatten wrapper divs; virtualize long lists; split oversized templates
validation_method: Count nodes in rendered DOM (script); compare to Lighthouse thresholds

requirement: No excessive DOM depth from wrapper nesting
pass_condition: max nesting depth <= 32
fail_condition: max_depth > 32
solution_pattern: Remove redundant nesting; use CSS layout instead of wrapper chains

trigger: element carries an explicit role= or aria-*
requirement: Only ARIA roles/attributes permitted by html-aria for that element are used
pass_condition: every explicit role and aria-* is allowed for the element per data/allowed_aria.csv
fail_condition: a prohibited role or prohibited aria-* is present on the element
solution_pattern: remove/replace the disallowed role or attribute; rely on the element's implicit semantics
